note: Both sets capture the same core Nitinol claims accurately, with correct values, units, conditions and supporting quotes. Set A additionally includes the commercially available wire transition temperature of 90 C, which is explicitly stated in footnote 3 ('transition at temperatures of 70C and 90C') and is omitted by Set B. No claim in either set is misread, misbound or invented, so A's extra correct claim makes it the better set.
remarks: Both sets faithfully reproduce the page's stated composition figures (55-65% Nickel and 44-55% Titanium), which sum to more than 100% as written in the source; this is a source-document inconsistency, not an extraction error. The 70C and 90C transition temperatures come from a footnote reference and could arguably be merged into a single range claim.
